name: Flowing Letters
description: Letters filled with thin wavy lines of colour that flow sideways like water, drawn on a canvas in the surrounding font.

props.name: text
props.description: The text. It is laid out by the page in the inherited font and stays selectable and readable by assistive tech; the canvas paints over it.

props.name: colors
props.description: Line colours, blended from the top of the letters to the bottom: seafoam, water, wisteria by default. Any CSS colour or token; re-read when the theme changes.

props.name: lineWidth
props.description: Stroke width of each line, in pixels.

props.name: curve
props.description: Height of the waves above and below their rest line, in pixels.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds for one wave to pass. The canvas pauses off screen and in hidden tabs, and holds still under reduced motion.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the wrapping span, an inline block. Other span props are passed through.
